candidates.text: Which conventional reference meridian is assigned longitude 000°?
options: The Greenwich prime meridian
The magnetic meridian through magnetic north
The Equator
Every meridian through a geographic pole
candidates.tr_text: Hangi geleneksel referans meridyenine 000° boylam verilir?
candidates.explanation_tr: Boylam Greenwich başlangıç meridyeninin doğusu/batısı olarak ölçülür. Ekvator ise enlem için 0° referansıdır.
candidates.explanation_en: Longitude is referenced east or west of the Greenwich prime meridian; the Equator is the zero-latitude reference.
candidates.distinctness_evidence: Existing bank tests latitude/longitude ranges but not which reference is longitude zero.

candidates.text: Which pair of points defines the Earth rotation axis, which is perpendicular to the equatorial plane?
options: The geographic North and South Poles
The magnetic North and South Poles
Greenwich and its antipodal point
The two intersections of the Equator and magnetic equator
candidates.tr_text: Ekvator düzlemine dik olan Dünya dönüş eksenini hangi iki nokta belirler?

candidates.explanation_en: The rotational axis passes through the geographic poles; magnetic poles are different and migrate.

answer_verification.section: Chapter16,Basic Navigation,Earth meridians/parallels and geographic poles pp16-2–16-3

candidates.distinctness_evidence: 15691 asks axis tilt;15721 defines true north. This distinguishes geographic versus magnetic endpoints of the rotation axis.

candidates.text: Assume a spherical Earth where 1° of latitude is 60 NM. Two points lie on 60°N at 020°E and 030°E. What is the distance along that parallel (rhumb line)? Usecos 60°=0.5.
options: 300 NM
600 NM
150 NM
candidates.tr_text: 1° enlemin 60 NM olduğu küresel Dünya yaklaşımını kullan. İki nokta 60°N üzerinde 020°E ve 030°E’dedir. Paralel boyunca kerte hattı mesafesi kaçtır?cos 60°=0,5.
candidates.explanation_tr: Boylam farkı 10°; paralel mesafesi 10×60×cos 60°=300 NM. Enlem küçüldükçe boylam arası mesafe artar; meridyen üzerindeki enlem farkı hesabıyla karıştırma.
candidates.explanation_en: Parallel distance=longitude difference×60×cos (latitude)=10×60×0.5=300 NM. This differs from meridian latitude-distance arithmetic.

answer_verification.section: Longitude:degree spacing at60degrees ishalf-equatorial spacing; sphericalparallel-radiuscos(latitude) derivation used with suppliedcos60=0.5

candidates.distinctness_evidence: 15775/15752 compute latitude distance along a meridian. Constant-latitude east/west distance requires the additional cosine factor.

candidates.text: At the end of evening civil twilight, what is the position of the Sun centre relative to the unobstructed geometric horizon?
options: 6° below it
6° above it
12° below it
18° below it

answer_verification.section: Twilight definitions: centre6° below horizon at evening civil twilight end

candidates.tr_text: Düz ve engelsiz ufuk için geleneksel astronomik tanımda gün doğumu ve gün batımını Güneş diskinin hangi kısmı belirler?

İki olayda da merkezin ufku geçmesi

candidates.explanation_en: Sunrise/set conventionally use the apparent upper limb at the horizon; civil twilight instead uses solar-centre depression.

answer_verification.section: Rise,Set definitions and technical conventions: upperedge ofSun disk

answer_verification.section: Equinox/dynamicalequinox:intersection ofecliptic andcelestial equator;solar declinationchangesfromsouth tonorth

candidates.text: What does a conformal aeronautical chart projection preserve locally?
options: Angles and shapes of sufficiently small areas
The area of every region without distortion
An identical distance scale everywhere
Every great circle as a straight line
candidates.tr_text: Konformal havacılık haritası izdüşümü yerel olarak neyi korur?
tr_options: Yeterince küçük alanların açılarını ve şekillerini
Her büyük daireyi düz çizgi olarak

candidates.explanation_en: Conformality preserves local angles and small shapes. It does not mean equal area or globally constant distance scale.

answer_verification.section: Projections:conformal versus equal-area;angles within small area accurately reproduced

The longitude scale at any latitude
The latitude scale at the Equator regardless of route latitude
The compass-rose degree scale

candidates.explanation_en: One minute of latitude is approximately 1 NM, andMercator scale varies with latitude. Use the latitude scale close to the route, not longitude or a distant latitude.

answer_verification.section: ChapterVI,Mercator chart scale increases with latitude

candidates.distinctness_evidence: Existing questions defineNM andscale,but not the chart-margin technique under Mercator scale variation.

The OBS changes automatically to 270°
The receiver changes the aircraft magnetic heading
The CDI is always centred whenever TO appears
candidates.tr_text: Pilot 270°VOR radyali boyunca uzaklaşırken klasik CDI kullanıyor, fakat OBS 090°’da ve TO görünüyor. Bu karşıt kurs ayarı yanal düzeltmelere nasıl etki eder?

candidates.explanation_en: Use 270°/FROM for outbound 270°. Leaving reciprocal 090°/TO produces reversed lateral guidance for that direction of travel; heading does not set TO/FROM.

candidates.text: A conventional VOR CDI has 10° full-scale deflection to either side. Aircraft distance from the station is 60 NM (horizontal range; ignore height). The needle is one-fifth of full deflection. Using 1-in-60, approximately how far is the aircraft from the selected course?
options: 2 NM
1 NM
5 NM
10 NM
candidates.tr_text: Klasik VOR CDI’ın bir tarafa tam sapması 10°’dir. Uçağın yatay istasyon mesafesi 60 NM; yüksekliği ihmal et. İğne tam sapmanın beşte biri kadar sapmış. 1/60 kuralıyla seçili kurstan yaklaşık kaç NM uzaktadır?
candidates.explanation_tr: Açısal sapma 10°/5=2°.60 NM mesafede 2° yaklaşık 2 NM yanal mesafedir. VOR sapması açısal olduğu için aynı iğne sapması, istasyondan uzaklaştıkça daha büyük mesafe eder.
candidates.explanation_en: Angular deviation = 10°/5 = 2°. At 60 NM, the 1-in-60 rule gives about 2 NM lateral displacement. VOR CDI deflection is angular, so displacement grows with range.
candidates.distinctness_evidence: 15905 givesfull-scaledegrees and15834 uses track-error offtrack distance.This appliesfractionalCDItoVORrange.

candidates.text: A serviceable VOR receiver has OBS 090°. The aircraft is east of the station, on radial 085° (five degrees north of the 090° radial). Ignore overhead ambiguity. Which conventional CDI indications are expected?
options: FROM, needle right of centre
TO, needle right of centre
FROM, needle left of centre
TO, needle centred
candidates.tr_text: Çalışır VOR alıcısında OBS 090°. Uçak istasyonun doğusunda,085°radyali üzerinde(090°radyalin 5°kuzeyinde). Tepe belirsizliğini ihmal et. Klasik CDI nasıl gösterir?

candidates.explanation_en: OBS 090° selects the eastbound course, and the aircraft lies in the FROM half-plane. It is north/left of the course, so the course is right and the CDI deflects right. Heading does not change this position geometry.
candidates.distinctness_evidence: Existingbank onlycentresCDI.Candidate includes offcourseradialside plusTO/FROM position;sourcefigurevariants teachingthesamegeometry shareone item.
